title: Etale clopen partition adapted to a proper geometric fibre
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $s\in S$. There exist an etale morphism $g:U\to S$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], a point $u\in U$ with $g(u)=s$, and a finite family $V_i$ of pairwise disjoint open-and-closed subsets covering $X\times_SU$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. For each $i$, the inverse image of $V_i$ in the geometric fibre at $u$, taken over the algebraic closure of $\kappa(u)$ [def-weil-geometric-fibre] [def-weil-algebraic-closure], is connected and nonempty [def-weil-connected-scheme]. The finite family may be empty. No flatness hypothesis or assertion about other fibres is made.

proof.text: Choose a Spec neighbourhood j:Spec A→S of the marked point, with preimage s₀. Pull f back to f₀:X₀→Spec A. Apply affine Stein factorization to X₀.toSpecΓ and π=f₀.steinFactorizationBase, obtaining integrality of π and geometric connectedness of the first map. The Stein finite-fibre theorem gives the finite point fibre and finite residue extensions at s₀.

Apply integral-fibre etale splitting to π at s₀, obtaining g₀:U→Spec A, a marked u, and a finite clopen partition V_i of the base-changed Stein scheme. Set g=g₀≫j. The iterated-pullback isomorphism identifies pullback f g with pullback f₀ g₀. A pullback lift constructs q:pullback f g→pullback π g₀, compatible with the projections. Pullback pasting proves this is a base change of X₀.toSpecΓ, hence q is geometrically connected.

Take the partition q⁻¹(V_i). Closedness follows from continuity; Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf proves disjointness and preimage_iSup proves the covering equality. Etaleness of g follows by composition with the initial open immersion, and g(u)=s by the two marked-point equalities. This works for m=0 as well.

Apply isConnected_geometricFibre_preimage to q, the Stein-scheme projection r, the total projection p, their pullback-lift equality q≫r=p, and each V_i. The splitting theorem supplies its unique-point and purely-inseparable hypotheses. Its conclusion is definitionally the connectedness of the geometric inverse image of q⁻¹(V_i) required here.

theorem Scheme.Hom.exists_etale_geometricFibre_clopen_partition
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f] (s : S) :
    ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (g : U ⟶ S) (u : U), Etale g ∧ g u = s ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (V : Fin m → (pullback f g).Opens),
        (∀ i, IsClosed (V i : Set ↥(pullback f g))) ∧
        Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (V i) (V j)) ∧ (⨆ i, V i) = ⊤ ∧
        ∀ i, _root_.IsConnected
          ((pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g)
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (algebraMap (U.residueField u) (AlgebraicClosure (U.residueField u)))) ≫
                U.fromSpecResidueField u)) ⁻¹' (V i : Set ↥(pullback f g)))
